messages:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — can someone run a quick pairwise SKU pass comparing A100 / H100 / L40S for our 8k longctx workload? Need p99 numbers + a tiny thermal note.
Maya Singh: I can spin one up later today. do you want the usual mini-suite or full sweep?
Alex Kim: Mini-suite for now (latency p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, gpu temp). If it looks odd, we can escalate to full.
Jordan Lee: @Maya if you hit high p99 on H100, add a small-run with `--disable-nvlink` to check NVLink impact.
Maya Singh: got it. planning: 3 runs per SKU, seeds 42/43/44, cache warmed. I'll tag results.
Sam Patel: Re: infra — only H100 rack 3 has the new driver. FYI if you want clean apples-to-apples use rack2 H100.
Maya Singh: ack. will prefer rack2 H100 to match A100/A40S optics.
Alex Kim: bench-bot, schedule a mini-pairwise job for maya on eng-runtime-queue with high-priority.
bench-bot: Request received. Job ID: bb-1769876543-3. Queue: eng-runtime. ETA: ~45m.
Maya Singh: Starting run now. command I used: `bench run --suite mini --models a100,h100,l40s --ctx 8192 --runs 3 --out /tmp/sku-mini-1769876543.csv`
Tanya Chen: quick question — are we running quantized variants or fp16?
Maya Singh: FP16 baseline. if we see large deltas will queue quantized sweep.
Jordan Lee: sample csv header to expect: `sku,seed,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens_per_sec,gpu_temp_c,run_id`
Maya Singh: uploaded raw csv: https://internal.redwood/s3/bench/sku-mini-1769876543.csv :eyes:
Alex Kim: Thanks — Maya can you paste p99 summary here once available? I'll add to the perf board.
Maya Singh: p99 summary (3-run median): A100=218ms, H100=205ms, L40S=250ms. Temps: A100=72C, H100=78C, L40S=68C.
Sam Patel: interesting — H100 faster but hotter. that's within expected. can you check power draw in nvml logs?
Maya Singh: grabbing nvml logs now, will attach.
bench-bot: nvml logs attached to job bb-1769876543-3 (s3://internal.redwood/logs/bb-1769876543-3-nvml.tar.gz)
Maya Singh: NVML peak power: H100=340W, A100=300W, L40S=210W.
Jordan Lee: That power delta explains the temp/p99 split. For follow-up: add `--fan 80` test on H100 to see thermal -> perf tradeoff.
Alex Kim: Good plan. Also, if anyone suspects a regression vs last month, compare to `bench/sku-archive/2026-11-mini.csv` (I think that's the baseline).
Tanya Chen: FYI I'm going to capture these numbers into the SKU comparison doc and flag the H100 power note.
Maya Singh: scheduling the fan test next (low priority). Will update thread with new job id when done.
Alex Kim: Perfect — thanks team. If the H100 fan test reduces p99 by >5% we should add a doc note for ops to prefer higher fan for heavy longctx workloads. :thumbsup:
